conceptZh: 玩具機器人站在小果樹下張開雙手準備接蘋果，蘋果卻不偏不倚輕輕落在他頭頂上；他一動也不動地頂著蘋果站好，還慢慢比出一個讚，接著蘋果攤平成上面的「田」，樹幹伸展成下面的「木」，合成「果」。
object: a small toy robot, a little toy fruit tree and one big apple
morph: the apple flattens into the 田 on top while the trunk and branches stretch into the 木 below, forming 果
creativeAngle: 笑點是「張開雙手接，結果接到頭上」的老派物理喜劇，輕輕一碰不痛不嚇人；而蘋果在上、樹幹在下正好就是果字的田在上、木在下，變形邏輯完全對上。果只有八畫，適合完整組裝。語音詞「水果」，水ㄕㄨㄟˇ已學過，兩字都是單一讀音。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale sky background. Centered stands a stubby toy fruit tree with one large glossy red apple hanging from it, and a small boxy toy robot plants himself underneath with both hands cupped open, absolutely ready. From 1.0 second the apple wobbles, detaches - and lands softly on the flat top of his head with a gentle bonk, nowhere near his waiting hands. He does not flinch. He stays perfectly still, apple balanced, hands still cupped. Beat. At 2.4 seconds, without moving his head a millimetre, he slowly raises one thumb. At 3.0 seconds the apple flattens and squares off above him into a neat box divided by a cross of strokes, while the tree's trunk and branches stretch and straighten beneath it into a crossed upright with two sweeping strokes at the base. The robot steps out from between them and hops out of frame to the right by 4.4 seconds. By 4.8 seconds the shapes have resolved into one correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 果 in saturated deep crimson, perfectly centered and uncropped, filling about 70% of the frame height with generous margins, its upper 田 and lower 木 clearly separated and every stroke crisp. From 4.9 to 8.0 seconds the frame holds completely still on 果 with nothing else moving in the shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「果、果、水果」, using the reading ㄍㄨㄛˇ for 果 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 果 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 水果 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 果: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.

conceptZh: 扭蛋小怪獸從蛋殼彈出，撞一下小樹，蘋果掉成「田」，樹幹撐成「木」。
object: gachapon fuzzy creature, small apple tree
morph: apple pieces slide into the square 田, tree trunk becomes 木
creativeAngle: 先拼出一個歪掉的蘋果山，再一撞修正成田加木。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy, locked frontal camera. Setting: a soft peach stage with a pale-green floor; the glyph is a solid crimson 田 sitting on an olive-green 木. A round fuzzy pocket creature bursts out of a split gachapon capsule at left; a slim toy tree stands at right. The Traditional Chinese glyph 果 stays centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the capsule pops open with a gentle crack and the fuzzy creature bounces out, ricocheting off the capsule and the tree trunk; the first 果 is spoken at the first bounce. Moment two (1.8-3.5s): the creature proudly stacks four red apple cubes into a lopsided pyramid, blinks at it, shrugs, and bumps it once with its belly so the cubes slide into a neat square 田 with a cross inside, while the trunk stretches into 木 below; the second 果 is spoken as the cross clicks in. Moment three (3.5-5.0s): a sugar-candy bunch rolls out of the capsule; the creature catches one in its mouth and its eyes cross happily; 糖果 is spoken as a swirl of candy pops in beside it. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 果 is perfectly still and unobstructed; the creature hops in a circle beside the glyph, then rolls back into its half capsule like a hat. Narration (off-screen only, Taiwanese Mandarin, unhurried, every tone clear, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「果、果、糖果」, read as ㄍㄨㄛˇ、ㄍㄨㄛˇ、ㄊㄤˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ. Timing: first utterance at about 0.5s, second at about 2.6s, the word at about 4.4s; then stop, no repeats and no extra speech. Beneath the voice only bouncy squeaks and a soft candy crinkle, no music. The single glyph is the only on-screen text; the vocabulary stays audio-only with no subtitles, watermark, clutter or flashing.

conceptZh: 拉布拉多警長吹哨要把滿地水果堆整齊，越疊越高、踮腳搖晃，最後放上一顆小櫻桃，整座果塔垮下來：水果擠成上面的「田」，木頭果架撐成下面的「木」，警長被埋在旁邊只露出眼睛。
object: a big cartoon Labrador sheriff dog, a wooden fruit stand with one tall center post, and a heap of toy fruit
morph: the toppling fruit squashes into the square 田 with its inner cross around the top of the stand's post; the post becomes the long vertical, the crossbar becomes the horizontal, and the two legs splay into the sweeping strokes of 木, forming 果
creativeAngle: 不再用機器人接蘋果或扭蛋怪獸，改成警長「維持秩序」的疊果塔：想要整齊、越疊越歪、停一拍、全部垮下，垮下的瞬間就排成「果」。木架的中柱同時當 田 和 木 的那一豎，筆畫關係清楚；警長埋在字旁邊不遮筆畫，說「水果」時他頂著三種水果冒出來，聽到的和看到的是同一件事。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy-cartoon comedy, one locked frontal shot on a clean solid pale butter-yellow background with a flat pale-mint floor. Only three things are ever on screen: a big friendly cartoon Labrador sheriff dog with a gold star badge and a whistle on a cord, a simple wooden fruit stand with one tall center post, a short crossbar and two splayed legs, and a heap of chunky toy fruit (red apples, pears, oranges, a tiny cherry).

0.0-1.5s: the fruit lies scattered around the stand. The sheriff trots in from the left, stops, toots his whistle, and points a firm paw at the mess: this will be tidied. He slaps the first apple onto the crossbar with a proud nod; the first 果 is spoken on that slap.

1.5-3.4s: he stacks faster and faster, fruit on fruit, rising above the post. He goes up on tiptoe, then onto one hind paw, tongue out, the tower leaning left, then right, swaying wider with every piece while his tail wags harder.

3.4-4.2s: he holds up the tiny cherry, places it on the very top with two careful claws, and freezes. Everything stops for one beat. The cherry wobbles.

4.2-5.0s: the whole tower comes down in a big soft tumbling heap with a cartoon WHUMP. The fruit squashes together around the top of the post into a neat square frame with a cross inside, forming 田, while the post stands as one long vertical running from the top of that square straight down, the crossbar stays as the horizontal, and the two legs splay into the two sweeping lower strokes of 木. The second 果 is spoken as the last stroke snaps into place. By 5.0s this is one correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 果 in a single solid deep crimson, centered and uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with generous margins, every stroke crisp. The sheriff is buried in a small spill of leftover fruit just to the right of the glyph's base, only his eyes and hat brim poking out.

5.0-8.0s: the glyph 果 stays perfectly still and unobstructed. At about 6.0s, as 水果 is spoken, the sheriff pops up out of the spill with a banana and a pear balanced on his nose and a bunch of grapes sitting on his hat, grinning dizzily. He gives a small wobbly stagger, straightens his badge, and toots one quiet whistle, never touching or covering the strokes.

Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but not neon, no white blowouts, no dark or moody grading.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 「果、果、水果」(ㄍㄨㄛˇ、ㄍㄨㄛˇ、ㄕㄨㄟˇ ㄍㄨㄛˇ), reading exactly those syllables slowly and distinctly with clear tones, no erhua. First 果 at about 0.8s, second 果 at about 4.8s, 水果 at about 6.0s, then silence; do not repeat the character or the line. Under the voice only soft fruit thuds, a gentle whistle toot and a cushioned WHUMP, no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only: the single character 果 is the only text on screen, with no subtitles, vocabulary text, letters, numbers, watermark, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph or flashing effects.
